description: This file defines configuration utilities and error handling for setting up camera sessions, including adding camera input, photo output, and movie output with optional audio support.

methods.name: addCameraInput
methods.description: Adds a camera input to the AVCaptureSession, throws if it fails.

methods.name: addPhotoOutput
methods.description: Adds a photo output to the AVCaptureSession and configures quality prioritization.

methods.name: addMovieOutput
methods.description: Adds a movie output to the session with optional audio input and specified duration.
